detail.longDescription:
I can't blame devs for charging subscriptions for their apps or SaSs: we gotta eat, afterall.

But its exhausting when every other app asks you for a subscription.

Shit like this is why I believe UBI is essential. I'd be so content to make the best possible FOSS software I could make if I got paid a UBI.

Obviously, this doesn't count for running operations... I'm thinking more of apps etc

#Programming
